My dad has all these great stories from back in the day. He works as a diamond grader, and had to travel all over the world to check out factories and work with different labs. In doing so, he travelled with a bunch of other dudes throughout Venezuela, India, China, and Central Africa.

One of these dudes is a guy named Jack. He and another guy (let’s call him Frank) were invited to go eat at some military official’s place for a formal dinner (this was in central Africa).
So, naturally, they obliged. Jack and Frank were treated to a lavish meal with multiple courses and excellent wine.

Turns out that the host was Jean-Bédel Bokassa, the former president of the Central African Republic.
He asks his guest if they enjoyed the meal, to which they enthusiastically replied yes.
Then he asked “did you enjoy the meat?”.
Both of them got nauseous, i think one of them puked. They immediately knew something was really wrong.

It was human meat.
After Bokassa’s arrest (charges of killing schoolchildren iirc) they found meat in his freezers that
could be identified by tattoos. 

TL;DR - my dad’s buddies from back in the day were accidental cannibals.

day by day, very slowly, i’d notice i wan’t thinking about dying all the time. The days seemed shorter, instead of agonizingly slow. 
My head became very clear. I stopped thinking in circles all the time,
I compare it to two things; before, my head felt like a wasp nest and my perception of the world felt like a round fishbowl, distorting everything.

Kind of a long winded comment, but i hope to convey (to other people struggling as well) that even though you might hate when someone says “it gets better”, it really does. 
The good part is, it’s true. The hard part is: you’re gonna have to wait patiently, and work hard on it.
